prompt.en: In what year was Magna Carta signed?
prompt.fr: En quelle année la Magna Carta a-t-elle été signée?

explanation.en: Magna Carta was signed in England in 1215. It is the start of the 800-year-old tradition of ordered liberty that Canadians inherited.
explanation.fr: La Magna Carta a été signée en Angleterre en 1215. Elle marque le début de la tradition de liberté ordonnée, vieille de 800 ans, dont les Canadiens ont hérité.

source.quote: Together, these secure for Canadians an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England (also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms)

verification.evidence: an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England
